rationale: Retain IPX Power as the U.S. grid-tied solar-and-storage platform carved out when Google closed its acquisition of Intersect on March 10, 2026. Correct the existing TPG owner from the unsupported Peppertree Fund X attribution to TPG Rise Climate, preserve TPG's disclosed majority position, and add Climate Adaptive Infrastructure and Greenbelt Capital Partners as disclosed minority owners. Climate Adaptive Infrastructure provides the qualifying infrastructure-fund basis; TPG Rise Climate is a climate-private-equity strategy and Greenbelt's specific holding vehicle is not publicly disclosed. Exact percentages, securities and holding SPVs are not publicly disclosed, and no later sale or signed ownership transfer was identified.

companyFieldUpdates.description: IPX Power, LLC is an independent power producer that develops, owns and operates grid-tied utility-scale solar generation and battery-storage assets in California and Texas. It was launched on March 10, 2026 when Google closed its acquisition of Intersect Power: IPX retained Intersect's grid-tied portfolio and pipeline, while Google acquired the separate digital-power and data-center business. At launch, IPX reported approximately 4.4 GW of solar photovoltaic capacity and 8.8 GWh of battery storage across operating and construction-stage assets, plus a multi-gigawatt pipeline. TPG Rise Climate holds a disclosed majority position, with Climate Adaptive Infrastructure and Greenbelt Capital Partners as minority investors; exact percentages and holding SPVs are not publicly disclosed. Climate Adaptive Infrastructure's dedicated infrastructure vehicle provides the qualifying census basis, while TPG Rise Climate and Greenbelt are preserved as factual co-owners without being treated as separate qualifying infrastructure-manager holdings. No later sale or signed ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
